Fixed {data-navmenu="Parameters"}
================================================================================

Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r, results = "asis"}
groups <- tinyAM:::.fixed_parameter_groups(fixed_par)
for (category in names(groups)) {
  parameter_group <- groups[[category]]
  rendered <- knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    paste("###", category), "",
    "```{r}",
    'd <- plot_rows(parameter_group, "est")',
    "if (nrow(d)) plot_par(d, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols) else plotly::plot_ly()",
    "```", ""), quiet = TRUE)
  cat(rendered, sep = "\n")
}
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
for (component in c("F", "N", "M")) {
  process_sd <- pop[[paste0("sd_", component)]]
  if (is.null(process_sd)) next
  keys <- intersect(c("model", "fleet", "age", "age_block"), names(process_sd))
  process_sd <- process_sd[!duplicated(process_sd[keys]), ]
  rendered <- knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    paste("###", component, "process SD"), "",
    "```{r}",
    'sd_args <- list(data = plot_rows(process_sd, "est"), x = if ("age" %in% names(process_sd)) ~age else ~age_block,',
    '  color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Process SD")',
    'if ("fleet" %in% names(process_sd)) sd_args$split <- ~fleet',
    'do.call(plot_trend, sd_args)',
    "```", ""), quiet = TRUE)
  cat(rendered, sep = "\n")
}
```
